c11_acc_cbse_08_009: Closing stock isn't income — it's a reduction in cost of goods sold, so it credits the Trading Account. It raises profit by cutting cost, not by adding revenue.
c12_acc_cbse_09_002: Three-month maturity isn't enough — a cash equivalent must also carry insignificant risk of value change. Equity fund units fluctuate, so they don't qualify.
c11_acc_cbse_08_010: Watch the direction: outstanding means benefit already consumed → add to expense, create liability; prepaid means not yet consumed → deduct, create an asset.
c12_acc_cbse_09_003: Classification follows the activity's role in that business — buying shares is investing for a manufacturer but operating for a broker. Check the main business.
c11_acc_cbse_08_011: Ask who holds the right: income earned but not received is a receivable (asset); income received before earning is a liability. Don't swap the two.
c12_acc_cbse_09_004: Direct method isn't indirect rearranged — build the T-account: cash collected = opening receivables + revenue − closing receivables. Rising receivables mean less cash.
c11_acc_cbse_08_012: Depreciation and bad debts are non-cash — no money moves. Credit the asset or debtors, never Bank. Check: did cash actually flow?
c12_acc_cbse_09_005: Don't just add or deduct by rule — ask whether the change consumed cash or freed it. Rising receivables mean sales booked but cash not collected: deduct.
c11_acc_cbse_09_001: Adjustments aren't error fixes — they split each amount into this period's share (P&L) and next period's share (Balance Sheet). The same logic covers income too.
c12_acc_cbse_09_006: Investing means long-term assets and investments — inventory, trading securities and cash equivalents don't count. Check the purpose and the holding period.
c11_acc_cbse_09_002: Closing stock credits the Trading Account because it reduces cost of goods sold — it's not a sale or a purchase. If it's in the Trial Balance, credit Purchases instead.
c12_acc_cbse_09_007: A proposed dividend isn't cash out until shareholders approve and it's actually paid — the outflow lands in the year of payment, not proposal.
c11_acc_cbse_09_003: For outstanding expenses, debit the existing expense account again and credit the new liability. For prepaid, credit expense and debit the new asset.
c12_acc_cbse_09_008: 'Tax paid' isn't all operating — dividend distribution tax is financing and capital-gains tax is investing. Split it when the break-up is given.
c11_acc_cbse_09_004: Accrued income is a right to receive → debit the asset, credit income. Income in advance is an obligation → debit income, credit the liability. Ask which side holds the right.
c12_acc_cbse_09_009: Interest received is income in the P&L but investing in the cash flow — deduct it from operating profit under the indirect method and show it under investing.
c11_acc_cbse_09_005: Depreciation isn't money saved for replacement — it's cost allocation with no cash reserve created. Credit the asset or a provision account, not a 'fund' liability.
c12_acc_cbse_09_010: The 'rising current liability = add' rule fits operating items only — short-term borrowings and current maturities of long-term debt belong to financing.
c11_acc_cbse_09_006: Provision for doubtful debts isn't a liability — it's a valuation allowance deducted from Debtors. Show debtors net of the provision on the asset side.
c12_bio_cbse_01_001: Asexual reproduction isn't a 'lower organism' trait — strawberries, aphids and starfish do it too, while yeast and Paramecium have sexual phases. Check the species, not the 'level'.
c11_acc_cbse_09_007: Sequence matters: deduct further bad debts, then the new doubtful-debts provision, then compute discount on the good debtors that remain.
c12_bio_cbse_01_002: Amoeba divides along any plane; Paramecium only transversely — body structure sets the cleavage. And fragmentation makes new individuals; regeneration just repairs parts.
c11_acc_cbse_09_008: Interest on capital and interest on drawings aren't opposites to net off — one is your expense, the other your income. Record and show each separately.
c12_bio_cbse_01_003: Cloning isn't perfectly error-free — somatic mutations and somaclonal variation can creep in during mitosis and tissue culture. 'Vegetative' doesn't guarantee identical.
c11_acc_cbse_09_009: Goods on approval aren't sold yet — reverse the whole sale at invoice price and bring stock back at cost; there's no unrealised profit to provide for.
c12_bio_cbse_01_004: Pre-fertilisation starts with gametogenesis — meiosis halves the chromosome number here, well before pollination or mating. Look for the microscopic events first.
c11_acc_cbse_09_010: For unrecorded items, analyse what was wrongly booked and fix both aspects. And 'commission after charging' means the base is profit net of commission — solve algebraically.
